title: Model Immunization Beyond Condition Numbers: The Importance of Plateau Regions
abstract: arXiv:2611.20472v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Harmful fine-tuning can rapidly compromise safety alignment in Large Language Models, underscoring the vulnerability of deployed models to post-release modification. While prior work motivates model immunization by inducing ill-conditioned curvature to slow harmful optimization, this approach is not scalable due to the high computational cost of Hessian estimation. We refine this paradigm by extending the theoretical framework to prioritize plateau regions alongside curvature. We further introduce an immunization algorithm based on efficient Hessian estimation and bounds on the extremal singular values of the Hessian. translated_title: 超越条件数的模型免疫：平台区域的重要性
translated_abstract: 有害微调会迅速破坏大语言模型的安全对齐，凸显了已部署模型在发布后面临修改的脆弱性。尽管先前的工作提出通过诱导病态曲率来减缓有害优化以实现模型免疫，但由于Hessian估计的计算成本高昂，这种方法难以扩展。我们通过将理论框架扩展至在关注曲率的同时优先考虑平台区域，对这一范式进行了改进。我们进一步提出了一种基于高效Hessian估计以及Hessian极端奇异值边界的免疫算法。我们在三个应用场景中展示了所提出的免疫框架：(i) 微调即服务场景，其中良性用户数据可能混入投毒的有害数据；(ii) 开放权重场景，其中攻击者可针对仅含有害的数据、以不同训练动态进行微调；(iii) 鲁棒遗忘，其中……
tldr: 该论文将模型免疫的理论框架从仅依赖病态曲率（条件数）扩展到同时重视损失面的平台区域，并提出基于高效Hessian估计和极端奇异值边界的免疫算法，以在多种实际场景中防御有害微调对大语言模型安全对齐的破坏。
en_tdlr: This paper extends model immunization theory beyond ill-conditioned curvature to also prioritize plateau regions, and introduces an efficient immunization algorithm based on Hessian estimation and extremal singular value bounds to protect LLM safety alignment against harmful fine-tuning across multiple practical scenarios.
